# 7 Sketch Designers

> Multidisciplinary Architectural, Interior Design and Project Management Consultancy (PMC) firm based in Pune, India, with 12+ years of industry experience.

7 Sketch Designers delivers commercial and corporate spaces across architecture, interior design, project management consultancy, and turnkey interior execution, and operates an in-house German CNC furniture manufacturing facility (Module F Homes). The studio is Pune-based and works primarily through referrals from past clients.

## Services

- Architectural Consultancy: spatial master planning, working drawings and municipal drawings for corporate, hotel, hospital, college and industrial projects.
- Project Management Consultancy (PMC): end-to-end control over planning and budgeting, procurement and site, monitoring and control, and handover.
- Interior Design: commercial and institutional interior design for offices, hospitality, healthcare and education.
- Turnkey Interior Execution: single-point accountability for civil, electrical, flooring, painting, in-house-manufactured furniture, and MEP coordination.

## Manufacturing

- Module F Homes (in-house CNC factory): German CNC precision manufacturing producing modular woodwork for 7 Sketch Designers own clients and associate partners. 50% faster fit-out delivery, off-site pre-fabrication with zero on-site dust and noise, 10-year factory warranty on modular woodwork.

## Portfolio

Completed projects: Go Karting Recreational Hub, Suratwala Mark Plazzo, Pall Corporations, Wilo Sales Office, R R Heritage (Mahabaleshwar), Tata Service Centre (Moshi).

## Company

- 12+ years of industry experience, a 5-person team, Pune-based studio.
- Team: Rohit Wankhede (Founder and Principal Architect), Anita Wankhede (Founder, VK Infra Solutions / Accounts and Purchase), Deepa Vinayan (Senior Designer), Komal Narkar (Senior Designer), Hemangee Suryawanshi (Junior Designer).
- Associate partners: Integrity Vision Architects (IVA), Architects and Engineers, Akurdi, Pune; Module F Homes, Manufacturing Associate, Koregaon Park, Pune.
- Mission: deliver projects on time, maintain uncompromised quality, provide cost-effective solutions, build long-term client relationships, continuously innovate in design and execution.
